body:
⚠️ **Project-seat stub.** Job description: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/ui.md`. This is **`domain:ui` seat 1**, the lane's first post on this board: objectui became this repository's `ui/` workspace (#25825), and the lane's former post lived on the objectui board, which this seat cannot reach. No `domain:ui` post existed in the `pm:seat` index here (open or closed) when this one was raised.

- **Current PM:** 🟢 `os-steve` · 由 os-steve 账户的项目负责 (the Claude Code project "objectstack", seat thread "接管 ui 车道派发") · `session_017iXjUm1rujwDk7f3KT1Pkk`, seated on the maintainer's word in that project (「你开始负责 ui 车道，并发10」, 2026-10-26T06:20Z). Mutex readings at seating: no prior `domain:ui` post, no open `pm:dispatched` card in the lane, no assignee on any open lane card.
- **Second seat:** `domain:ui` seat 2 = #25995 (maintainer's word, 2026-10-26). The split is by the fix's landing package. Seat 2 holds plugin-list / grid / detail / form / view / kanban / calendar / gantt / map / timeline / tree / charts / dashboard / report and `fields`. After the 09:18Z rebalance it also holds the auth pages (login / register / invitation), the app-shell Setup / admin pages, marketplace and the console sidebar. Seat 1 holds everything else: i18n packs, `components` (form.tsx), Studio / designer, AI chat and build, approvals, tech-debt. Cards on one file stay with one seat and land in order.
- **Hot-file serial queue:** `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` are ⛔ out of bounds for every ui card for now (the ui-merge `pm:epic` subtree under #25677 is editing them; maintainer's word in the project). **No sdui records** since #26367 merged at 2026-10-27 01:27Z: `scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/` is retired, and CI's `Build & E2E UI` regenerates `sdui.manifest.json` and compares bytes on the PR and on the queue's merge tree. A branch that still carries a record takes the modify/delete with `git rm`. A PR lands once it is green and its merge-tree is clean. Only a real source-file overlap serialises. Two PRs on the same function get a merged-tree build before arming. Current file overlaps: `ObjectGrid.tsx` #25994 slices, one at a time (slice 6 building) · `ui/QUICK_REFERENCE.md` and the package-count floors: #26521 and #26365, whichever lands second merges `main`.
- **In flight (2026-10-27T08:20Z):** building: #25994 slice 6 · #26521 (ui floors → one shared package-count constant, Part of #26444) · #25922 (M) slice 1 (designer strings → a lazy i18n namespace) · #26382 (filter-builder `onChange` shape). Held: #25921 plugin-ai retirement (#26365; 18.2.0 has shipped; the only red is ADR-0087 refusing a whole-package removal, and the D9 wording question is with the maintainer) · #26220 (all four parts landed; open until that answer). Order rule (maintainer, 17:26Z): priority first across the lane. Landed since 10-26: #25858 · #25871 · #25872 · #25874 · #25877 · #25887 · #25888 · #25890 · #25892 · #25894 · #25897 · #25898 · #25899 · #25900 · #25901 · #25911 · #25917 · #25925 · #25934 · #25938 · #25992 · #25999 · #26126 · #26131 · #26172 · #26182 · #26183 · #26190 · #26194 · #26199 · #26275 · #26276 · #26304 · #26306 · #26346 · #26348 · #26418 · #26421 · #26438 · #26469 · #26470 · #26471, plus #25915 slices 1–2, #25994 slices 1–5, #25922 step 1 (#26219) and the app-shell unpublish (#26483), #26220 parts 1–4 (#26319, #26455, #26496), #25918 renderer props (#26293), the #25921 dead-keys slice, the #26443 ui half (#26516) and the #26460 ui flake reading (0/50). Filed: #26131 · #26199 · #26220 · #26304 · #26306 · #26314 · #26347 · #26348 · #26382 · #26421. Waiting on others: #25943 (cloud card). Back in the queue: #25918 remainder (after the ObjectGrid split) · #25915 remainder (components choice).
